in_marathi.name: Laltu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Laltu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Lalita’, meaning ‘the playful one’ or ‘the goddess of art, beauty, and grace’. In Hindu mythology, Lalita is a manifestation of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and arts.

in_bengali.name: Laltu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Laughing, Playful
in_bengali.long_meaning: Laltu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Lalita’, meaning ‘the playful one’ or ‘the goddess of art, beauty, and grace’. In Hindu mythology, Lalita is a manifestation of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and arts.
